name: Mixer Begins
steps: Drag the wrappers, cans, and trash into the green bin.
Grab the broom and sweep the dirty floor.
Move the sleeping roommate onto the lower bunk.
Use the wet cloth to clean the girl’s face and arms.
Replace the dirty quilt with the fresh pink blanket.
Take the makeup kit and apply makeup to her face.
Take the pink dress from the wardrobe and put it on her.
